description:
Tinker Air force AFSC/PZABC has a requirement to for Field Tester, PBG Oxygen Regulator which will be advertised under solicitation FA8119-26-Q-0003.  The scope of this requirement includes all management, personnel, and supervision, in addition to materiel, tools, equipment, transportation, and any other items and services to provide this material to meet the Government requirements.

Field Tester, PBG Oxygen Regulator

This is a pre-solicitation synopsis for SOLE SOURCE requirement in accordance with RFO 6.103-1 – 10 USC 3204(a)(1), Only One Responsible Source and no other supplies or services will satisfy Agency Requirements. OEM: EATON COMPANY this is NOT an official solicitation.   Please see the attached detail synopsis for further information.
